## ✅ Pre-merge Checklist

### For Author
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Breaking changes documented
- [ ] Security implications considered
- [ ] Compliance requirements verified
- [ ] Business stakeholders informed
- [ ] Rollback plan documented

### For Business Reviewers
- [ ] Business justification is clear and valid
- [ ] Business impact properly assessed
- [ ] Stakeholder communication planned
- [ ] Business success criteria defined

### For Technical Reviewers
- [ ] Technical implementation is sound
- [ ] Security implications reviewed
- [ ] Compliance requirements met
- [ ] Testing is adequate for change scope
- [ ] Rollback plan is feasible

*All percentages, financial figures, performance metrics, and KPI targets marked with asterisks (*) are example values created for demonstration purposes. Actual success metrics, costs, and performance improvements will vary based on specific organizational context and implementation details.*
